description: This file defines the internal class 'FieldIdAssignmentHelper' which is responsible for assigning and managing field identifiers for serialization purposes within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes methods for extracting field IDs from attributes, generating implicit IDs based on property names and types, and handling symbol mappings.

classes.name: FieldIdAssignmentHelper
classes.description: A helper class for assigning and managing field IDs for serialization, supporting both explicit annotations and implicit generation strategies.

methods.name: TryGetSymbolKey
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the assigned key (ID and constructor parameter flag) for a given symbol.

methods.name: HasMemberWithIdAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if any member has an explicit ID annotation.

methods.name: GetMembers
methods.description: Retrieves the relevant non-static, non-abstract, non-serialized members of a type.

methods.name: ExtractFieldIdAnnotations
methods.description: Extracts field IDs from attributes or constructor parameters and populates the symbol map.

methods.name: GetCanonicalNameAndFieldId
methods.description: Generates a canonical name and a hash-based field ID for a given type and name.

methods.name: GenerateImplicitFieldIds
methods.description: Generates implicit field IDs based on property names and types, ensuring no collisions.

methods.name: GenerateFromProperties
methods.description: Generates field IDs from properties, considering constructor parameters and property attributes.
